integrity: Complete exact rational 16-state generator reconstruction, positive-denominator check, polynomial coefficient identities, Descartes sign argument, and reproducible rational witnesses. Numerical thresholds are illustrative, not substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for four sites, saturated left/right reservoirs, boundary exchange and endpoint departure rates fixed to one, and two interior rates constrained to (r h,h) with r>1 and h>0. No large-volume or arbitrary-boundary-density result; possible unindexed earlier calculation; independent review not performed.
title: Two exact polarity reversals at fixed disorder contrast in a four-site exclusion chain
